feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: Following big Democratic wins, these swing voters are looking for results
entry.summary: For the swing voters NPR is regularly checking in with as part of its Swing Shift series, the election results brought mixed emotions, as does the pending Democratic control of Congress.

entry.title: House effectively ends Hegseth impeachment. And, 3 men accused of plotting U.K. attacks
entry.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has been spared from the House's impeachment effort, at least for now. And, federal prosecutors arrested three men accused of being Iran-backed operatives.

entry.title: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch
entry.summary: Descendants of President John F. Kennedy are asking a judge to block President Trump's monumental arch near Arlington National Cemetery.

entry.title: Ex-CIA officer on UK investigations into alleged Iran, Russia threats
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with former CIA senior executive clandestine service officer Daniel Hoffman about investigations in Britain into alleged threats linked to Iran and Russia.

entry.title: Iran-backed trio accused of plotting attacks on U.K. base hosting U.S. jets
entry.summary: Iran-backed operatives have been charged over nearly 20 attacks, including a plot on a U.K. base housing U.S. troops. Separately, a U.S. soldier is held in the U.K. on Russia spying claims.

entry.title: Close Trump ally to lead House Republicans next year
entry.summary: House Republicans will have a new leader at the start of the new Congress in January: Ohio's Jim Jordan, a co-founder of the ultra-conservative Freedom Caucus and a close ally of President Trump.

entry.title: House votes to end the impeachment effort against Pete Hegseth
entry.summary: The House was on course for a floor vote Wednesday on whether to impeach Pete Hegseth. That is until House Republicans used a procedural vote to effectively end the impeachment effort.

entry.title: Mixed results from ballot measures on abortion and trans issues
entry.summary: Midterm ballot measures on abortion and transgender issues saw mixed results.

entry.title: Steve Inskeep talks to ex-CIA analyst about alleged Nvidia Chinese spy case
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep talks with former CIA analyst Emily Harding about China's spy tactics in light of the alleged plot targeting the CEO of Nvidia.

entry.title: Republican advisor about discusses the GOP's leadership vote
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Hogan Gidley, a Republican consultant and advisor to House Speaker Mike Johnson, about the new GOP's leadership vote.
